newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 28.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 28.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
-- Pensions will rise by 16 to 17 percent next year, at a higher rate than inflation, Finance Minister Peter Medgyessy told the parliament.
-- The Hungarian and the Romanian presidents answered in a joint letter to U.S. president Bill Clinton, who had welcomed their meeting, which both of them called 'historic'.
-- Another restaurant has been closed in Budapest because it overcharged guests.
-- Independent think-tank GKI revised its GDP growth forecast for 1997 up.
